sections.advice: Treat Food stop near Bacchus Marsh → Saint Leonards as bend craft. Brake early, look high through the turn, and keep throttle changes gentle. It is more satisfying to link ten clean bends than rescue one silly one.

Use High point in Narre Warren → Scenic stretch near Bayswater North as clean positioning. Keep it tidy, ignore impatient traffic and save the enthusiasm for the good road ahead. The value here is not drama; it is arriving at the riding section with space, fuel and concentration intact.
